title: alchemilla alpina proles alpigena
intro: Alchemilla alpina proles alpigena, commonly known as Alpine Lady's Mantle, is a type of flowering plant in the rose family native to Europe and Western Asia. It has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and soothing skin irritations due to its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties. The therapeutic actions of Alpine Lady's Mantle include acting as a vulnerary to promote wound healing, a diuretic to aid in urine production, and an astringent to reduce excessive discharge. The bioactive constituents responsible for its therapeutic effects include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which have been shown to exhibit antioxidant and antimicrobial activities.
